description: Set a Kotlin Multiplatform (Android + iOS) app's version to an exact value across both platforms — the root `gradle.properties` `VERSION_NAME` (and, only for a release value, `VERSION_CODE` incremented by one), plus, only for a release value, the iOS host app's `iosApp/Configuration/Config.xcconfig` `MARKETING_VERSION` (set to the release) and `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION` (set to the new `VERSION_CODE`) — never writing a `-SNAPSHOT` value into any iOS file, since App Store Connect rejects it. Detects the layout at runtime and falls back, when the `iru-setup-kmp-app` layout isn't present, to `versionName`/`versionCode` literals in the Android app module's `build.gradle(.kts)` (`androidApp/`, `composeApp/`, `app/`), the `gradle/libs.versions.toml` `[versions]` entries the build reads them from, XcodeGen `project.yml` settings, a literal `Info.plist` `CFBundleShortVersionString`/`CFBundleVersion`, or a committed `project.pbxproj` `MARKETING_VERSION`. Invoke as `/iru-kmp-bump-version <new-version>` where `<new-version>` is the literal target version (`1.2.0` or `1.3.0-SNAPSHOT`) — this skill never computes a bump itself; `iru-release` computes the release/next-dev values per the pre-release convention in Step 5 and passes each one through. Also accepts `args`: `sync-files: yes|no` (default: ask) to also update README/Antora version mentions, `next-version: <upcoming-version>` so that sync maps "Latest release" markers to `<new-version>` and "Current development version"/"Latest snapshot" markers to the upcoming value, and `dry-run: yes|no` (default `no`) to print the diff without writing anything. Reports the old and new values of every field and every file touched. Equivalent to `iru-android-bump-version`/ `iru-swift-bump-version` for a KMP app. Use whenever the user, or `iru-release`, needs a KMP app's version set to a specific value instead of hand-editing Gradle properties and Xcode build settings.
